environment.c_compiler: Microsoft (R) C/C++ Optimizing Compiler Version 19.44.35229 for x64

protocol.paired_order: baseline then candidate, repeated three times
protocol.core_scope: input preloaded; write tree prepared; no startup or filesystem timing; JS GC outside samples
protocol.memory: three independent processes per revision, one operation, no warmup; full process peak working set/RSS
protocol.cli: five warmups followed by 30 full process invocations per revision; includes startup and disk I/O

protocol.timing: open, read, validate, select, close and serialize; process startup excluded; generated input excluded; warm OS cache; JS GC outside timing

scope: Full original cohorts, all samples retained. Both sides run the identical frozen revision: observed paired ratios describe variability and are not optimization or code-regression claims. Final file JS row was restarted in full after the original measuring process ended before producing a row; completed preceding rows are unchanged.
